seo.title: Legal Fees – Criminal Law Warsaw | Kowalski, Esq.
seo.description: Transparent legal service fees. Criminal and white-collar criminal law in Warsaw. Free consultation. From 400 PLN/h.

hero.headline: Transparent terms of cooperation
hero.subheadline: Legal fees tailored to the type and complexity of the case. The first consultation is free – get to know me and make a decision without any commitment. All costs are agreed before work begins.

consultation.title: Initial consultation
consultation.description: The first meeting is a free analysis of your legal situation. You will present the circumstances of the case, and I will assess the prospects, identify possible lines of defence, and propose a strategy. The meeting lasts up to 60 minutes and does not bind you to any obligations.
includes: Analysis of the circumstances of the case
Assessment of prospects and legal risks

pricing.title: Hourly rates and service packages
pricing.description: The rates below are effective from August 2026 and apply to cases conducted within Warsaw. For cases requiring travel outside the city, a travel surcharge is agreed individually. The final price depends on the complexity of the case and is always confirmed in writing before work commences.

features: Updates on the progress of the case

plans.name: Assistance after detention
features: Travel to the police station / court

plans.name: Misdemeanour cases
features: Analysis of the notice of offence

items.title: Advance payment on commencement
items.description: Before taking any action we sign an agreement that precisely defines the scope of work, the fee, and the payment schedule. The advance is typically 30-50% of the agreed amount.

items.title: Instalment option
items.description: For long-running cases I offer the possibility of instalment payments. Details are agreed individually depending on the type and expected duration of the case.

items.title: Transparency guarantee
items.description: No hidden costs. Any additional work beyond the agreement is agreed and approved before it is carried out. You have the right to know what you are paying for.

items.question: Are the prices negotiable?
items.answer: Yes. The final rate depends on the complexity of the case, the volume of evidentiary material, and the expected duration of the proceedings. The prices listed in the schedule are indicative ranges – a precise quote is prepared after the free consultation.

items.question: What if the case concludes sooner than expected?
items.answer: If the case concludes before the anticipated deadline, I proportionally reduce the fee. You are billed for the work actually performed, not for the estimated time.

items.question: Are court and expert costs included?
items.answer: No. Court fees, stamp duties, and expert and translator fees are covered by the client separately. Before commencing the case I estimate and communicate all anticipated ancillary costs.

items.question: Do you issue VAT invoices?
items.answer: Yes. The practice is an active VAT taxpayer. I issue invoices for all services. For business clients, it may be possible to deduct the cost of economic defence as a tax-deductible expense.

items.question: What about an appeal?
items.answer: If the case requires an appeal, the cost of second-instance representation is agreed separately. The prices in the schedule apply to one stage of proceedings. In court packages, the first appellate opinion is included in the price.
